Native Adventure odor text grammar, configured Windows DF 53.16 images

This is reconstructed native source and operand provenance for the requested
translation work. Addresses are RVAs. The images are selected by
data/runtime/native-pe-images.json; no running game is read or controlled.

Image identities
  Steam:   PE:6a70a6d9:02711000
  Classic: PE:6a70b91c:0270a000

Text owner / helper                  Steam                  Classic
  Main Adventure renderer           af1190..b03c40          aee1d0..b00c80
  Legacy Adventure renderer         80d5e0..8189ac          80ae60..81622c
  Controlling render wrapper        7f3cb0..7f6c21          7f1530..7f44a1
  Odor icon and hover block         af19f8..af1eee          aeea38..aeeddc
  Main strongest-odor field         b000e7..b0022f          afd11a..afd26f
  Legacy current odor field         81609f..8161d9          81391f..813a59
  Legacy travel odor field          8163ef..816522          813c6f..813da2
  Singular creature-name helper     aa3bd0..aa3d93          aa0c50..aa0e13
  Caste lookup leaf                 bba90..bbadd            bba20..bba6d
  First eligible letter uppercase   52d650..52d8ba          52b070..52b2da
  Complete string -> popup wrap     8e7310..8e7431          8e4b80..8e4ca1
  Announcement-kind caption leaf    749ee0..74bad4          747900..7494f4

Native data fields
  Steam current race/caste/death: 2643ccc / 2643cd0 / 2643cd4.
  Steam travel race/caste/death:  2643cd8 / 2643cdc / 2643ce0.
  Classic current fields:        263dbbc / 263dbc0 / 263dbc4.
  Classic travel fields:         263dbc8 / 263dbcc / 263dbd0.
  Caste ODOR_STRING is its std::string at +4270. This is a distinct RAW
  field, not a creature name and not a fragment of an English sentence.

Shared native value construction (identical branches in both images)
  odor_value(state, absent, death):
      if state.race == -1: return absent
      if state.death: return death
      caste = caste_lookup(state.race, state.caste)
      if caste != nullptr and not caste.ODOR_STRING.empty():
          return caste.ODOR_STRING
      return creature_name(state.race, plural=false, caste=-1)

The name helper checks negative/out-of-range race, then reads the creature's
NAME[0] at +20. All odor call sites pass plural=false and caste=-1; its other
caste/plural branches are retained in the complete helper assembly but never
selected by these callers. Invalid race or an empty NAME[0] returns "".
The actual static fallback nouns are retained with RAW file/line provenance
in odor-raw-creature-name-sources.tsv: 767 distinct creature NAME[0] strings
from the two configured installations. They reuse the existing full creature
vocabulary and grammar, rather than a second species glossary.

Hover paragraph
  The renderer-local [rbp-30] branch can skip the whole icon block. Within
  it, native mouse bounds and cache state determine whether the cached
  popup is reused or reconstructed; they do not introduce other text.
  if current.race == -1:
      no paragraph is constructed
  else:
      value = odor_value(current, unused, "death")
      text = "You smell " + value + "."
      wrap(text, width=24)

Death override uses lowercase "death". A nonempty ODOR_STRING is appended
literally, without capitalization. Missing caste and empty ODOR_STRING
select NAME[0]. Empty NAME[0] still gives the concrete native sentence
"You smell ."; no-race is a separate no-output branch, not "You smell None.".
The emitted complete sentence is translated before native line wrapping is
interpreted as layout. All fixed sentences and the empty-field sentence
live in tooltip-translations.tsv. The supported full {s} tooltip template
supplies the NAME[0]/complete term grammar for the dynamic branch.

Three strongest-odor fields
  The main renderer's mode word and flag bit 4 gate its field. The legacy
  renderer selects current or travel state with its native travel-mode byte.
  Each field draws "Strongest Odor: " independently, constructs
  odor_value(selected_state, "None", "Death"), uppercases its first eligible
  letter, and draws the value after the label. Paint-color branches inspect
  race == -1 but do not produce additional English strings.

The native capitalization helper has chained unwind ranges: its first
unwind record is not its complete function. Full code and extended-byte
dispatch tables are retained. It skips bracketed markup and exits after
the first eligible letter conversion. It leaves later words unchanged:
"bug innards" -> "Bug innards", not a title-cased pair of words.

The finite fields None/Death and all capitalized standard ODOR_STRING
outputs have complete UI-message entries in local-overrides.tsv. The
complete Strongest Odor: {s} UI template resolves NAME[0] through the shared
full-term/creature grammar. The standalone label entry also covers the
native empty-name field, for which no value is drawn.

Complete finite icon/ODOR_STRING dispatch
  A death override selects icon 5 before the icon classifier's no-race test.
  Otherwise no-race skips its glyph block; null caste, empty ODOR_STRING and
  an unrecognized string select icon 30. The twelve comparisons are:
    0 blood                   6 filth
    1 smoke                   7 soot
    2 mud                     8 vomit
    3 bug innards             9 soil
    4 cooked flesh           10 freshly-baked goods
    5 death                  11 brimstone
  Icon 30 also follows the existing creature/material icon fallback. These
  icon cases have no extra human-readable sentence. The ODOR_* texture
  tokens in the source parser are internal identifiers, not UI translations.

All twelve words also occur in the configured static RAW or procedural Lua
producers. odor-raw-text-sources.tsv retains their 38 actual source locations,
including night trolls, sphere-dependent odors and forced brimstone. Odor
level/trigger controls are retained separately in odor-raw-control-sources.tsv.
Fixed hover sentences and fixed strongest-odor fields are authored for all
twelve words, even when an unrelated general word entry already exists.

Related finite UI labels
  Announcement-kind enum 206 selects exactly "Check smells" from the caption
  leaf's 0..354 dispatch table. It labels a report kind and does not produce
  a second odor sentence. Its existing translation is "检查气味".
  Key metadata registers enum 357 (0x165) as A_ODOR with description
  "Adventure: Describe Odor", and enum 358 (0x166) as A_DISPLAY_ODOR with
  description "Adventure: Display Strongest Odor". Both visible descriptions
  are included in the authored local overrides; symbolic A_* names remain
  native identifiers.

Source artifacts
  Full owner assembly, selected text blocks, literal operands, calls and
  control branches are retained as steam-* and classic-* files. The detailed
  Classic reconstruction and its caption caller/virtual owner provenance are
  in classic-decompiled.txt. Runtime dictionaries are edited in place from
  these authored productions; no runtime data generator is invoked.
